note: EphemerisManager.GenerateGraph recorded through a stub chart. x values are JD. Series kinds: value (spline), perihelion (vertical line), now (vertical line at fakeNow).

cases.description: Magnitude of all sample comets over 2026-01-01..2027-01-01, maximum 12 (series entirely fainter are left out), now line inside the range.
Sun distance of 12P over 2010..2030 with explicit minimum 0 and maximum 20 (periodic perihelion lines).
Earth distance of 2P over 2 days (long date labels, interval = span/100).
Earth distance of all sample comets over 2026-06-01..2026-12-01 with no maximum: multiple mode defaults the maximum to 2 AU.
